rationale.consistency: Uses slices/maps helpers and lower-case comment style like surrounding code; threading order through options and Helper.options matches existing patterns.
rationale.edge_cases: Nil options, chained order options via existing, invalid order aborting with no residue, plugin init order all handled; delete(options,"order") is redundant after the clone and its comment misstates why.
rationale.scope: Core change is focused; RegisterDirectiveOrder rewrite is justified by the base append-aliasing bug, but cloning the whole options map is broader than needed and changes what callers can read back.
rationale.readability: Clear helper directiveOrderFor; nil-slice as 'no sorting' sentinel in buildSubroute is a bit magic though documented; comments somewhat chatty.
rationale.robustness: No global writes after init, no locks, default backing array never aliased, per-adaptation slice ownership is explicit; race-free by construction.
rationale.maintainability: Order is now an explicit parameter rather than hidden global reads; two sources (options vs plugin global) are mediated by one helper, though the bool->[]string signature repurposing is slightly implicit.
